verdict.rationale: Together's serverless docs say chat, image, audio, embedding and more are callable through one API. Dedicated docs pages cover text-to-image generation, image editing with reference images, and text/image-to-video generation, so non-chat modalities are clearly available on the same platform. missing for 10: explicit evidence of vision (image-input) chat models, dedicated audio (speech-to-text/TTS) documentation beyond a one-line mention, independent or hands-on corroboration.
